description: This file contains a report module for production analytics in the manufacturing module of ERPNext, generating a line chart and tabular data on work order statuses over periods.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate columns, data, and chart for the production analytics report.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Constructs report columns based on period ranges.

methods.name: get_periodic_data
methods.description: Aggregates work order data into status categories over periods.

methods.name: update_periodic_data
methods.description: Updates the count of work orders in a specific status for a period.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches work order entries and prepares data and chart for the report.
